purpose: Authorize a second future-only 32-image image-bound v3 E2 lineage from the remaining rebuilt prescreen-v2 pool after the first such lineage closed at 30 accepted rows.

evidence.result: 30 accepted rows; open-en-disease and open-zh-pest have three rows each; all other fixed cells have four.
evidence.sample_validation: One accepted item from each fixed cell passed image SHA, closed-rewrite, private-audit, and option-letter checks (8/8).
evidence.remaining_pool: 288 candidates, 36 per fixed cell, after excluding the first prescreen-v2 campaign on image/source/near-duplicate identity.

future_only_changes.source_selection: Freeze exactly four fresh identities per fixed cell from prescreen-v2, excluding all seven earlier source lineages including the first prescreen-v2 campaign.

qualification: Only a unique collection winner with a closed image-bound rewrite, independent private-audit acceptance, and conversion-gate admission can count. Confirmed rejects and the preceding campaign identities remain excluded. SFT remains separately unauthorized.
